title: Website / Create better campaigns
slide_intent: Separate navigation, promise and image because a website must orient visitors before asking them to act.
strategic_value: A pale green hero and large illustration can combine Mailchimp’s usable structure with its expressive drawing style.
demonstration: A browser mockup places compact navigation above a centered serif headline and short text, with a large reclining figure crossing the green-to-white boundary.
practical_value: Study how an illustration can cross a background division without disrupting the header.

content_islands.name: Navigation
content_islands.spec: Keep the compact logo, links and actions across the top.

content_islands.name: Promise
content_islands.spec: Center the headline and supporting copy in the green hero region.

content_islands.name: Illustration
content_islands.spec: Place the large drawing below the copy so it extends into the white lower field.

reference_purposes.Application: The artwork applies the identity to a full-width website hero.
